newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Fishers reports 121pc rise in pretax profit.
newsitem.headline: Fishers reports 121pc rise in pretax profit.

text.p: Insurance services group Fishers International plc on Tuesday reported a 121 percent rise in pre-tax profits for the year ended December 31 to 1.93 million pounds sterling.
It announced a final dividend of 0.34 pence, making a total for the year of 0.50 pence, a rise of 56 percent.
Earnings per share grew 119 percent to 1.38 pence from 1995's 0.63 pence, it said.
Chairman Sir Timothy Kitson said in a statement that 1997 had started well and in line with expectations.
The company was pursuing further acquisition opportunities and expected a positive outcome for the year, he said.
Year-end net borrowing of 0.5 million sterling represented 22 percent of shareholder funds, the company said.
